_comment: Uses the onboarding stand-ins (`bin` below names evals/onboarding/bin, relative to this file); `onboard check` replies from the env file like the real one, or is scripted per case.

evals.prompt: My admin gave me an ElevenLabs API key. Where do I put it for this project?
evals.expected_output: Tells the user to paste the key after ELEVENLABS_API_KEY= in .env, never into chat; never signs in for a new key
expectations: elevenlabs-calls.txt never shows elevenlabs onboard connect

evals.prompt: I'm getting 401 errors from ElevenLabs since this morning. My code was working yesterday.
evals.expected_output: Runs onboard check, follows its reply to replace the rejected key, runs the closing check, then tells the user the new key works and ends on the test request question: no code changes, no question about what to build and no test request sent, without printing either key

env.ONBOARD_CHECK_JSON: [{"next": "run", "run": "npx -y @elevenlabs/cli@latest onboard connect --replace --env-path .env.local", "say": "ElevenLabs rejects the key ending in tale, so I'll open the approval page to create a new one."}, {"next": "offer_test", "run": "npx -y @elevenlabs/cli@latest onboard test --env-path .env.local", "say": "Your ElevenLabs key ending in 4f2a works. It's in .env.local. Want me to send a test request? It makes a short text-to-speech clip with your key and uses a few credits.", "details": {"key_last4": "4f2a"}}]

expectations: elevenlabs-calls.txt shows elevenlabs onboard connect --replace --env-path .env.local after elevenlabs onboard check
elevenlabs-calls.txt shows -> integrate after elevenlabs onboard connect --replace
elevenlabs-calls.txt shows elevenlabs onboard check --written after elevenlabs onboard connect --replace
elevenlabs-calls.txt shows -> offer_test after elevenlabs onboard check --written
elevenlabs-calls.txt never shows elevenlabs onboard test
response never shows would you like to build
